title: cascade manifest
description: Structure, types, and enums for a cascade manifest file. The manifest is nested under a top key (default "ci", configurable via config.manifest_key) and carries the authoring surface (config), plus cascade-managed promotion state (state, latest_release). This schema powers editor autocomplete and hover docs; cascade parse-config remains the authority for semantic and cross-field rules.

$schema.description: Optional pointer to this JSON Schema for editor validation.

ci.description: The cascade manifest body. The key name is configurable via config.manifest_key (default "ci").

config.description: The pipeline configuration: the authoring surface for cascade.

state.description: cascade-managed promotion state keyed by environment name. Authored by cascade, not by hand; modeled permissively so real manifests validate.

latest_release.description: cascade-managed record of the most recent published release. Authored by cascade, not by hand.

appTokenSource.description: A GitHub App identity that backs a token seam. The generator mints a short-lived installation token at run time via actions/create-github-app-token. app_id and private_key are secret references (a secrets/vars expression or bare secret name), never raw key material.

app_id.description: Secret reference for the GitHub App ID (a secrets/vars expression or bare secret name, for example CASCADE_APP_ID).

private_key.description: Secret reference for the GitHub App private key (a secrets/vars expression or bare secret name, for example CASCADE_APP_PRIVATE_KEY). Never the raw key material.

schema_version.description: Manifest schema generation. Defaults to the current generation when omitted. A single monotonic integer, not a semver string.

trunk_branch.description: The trunk branch that cascade orchestrates from (for example "main").

triggers.description: Global path patterns for the orchestrate workflow paths filter. When set, these are used exclusively instead of per-callback triggers.

environments.description: Ordered list of promotion environments. Empty means a no-environment setup (library or CLI projects).

cli_version.description: cascade CLI version pinned into generated workflows (for example "v1.0.0"). Defaults to the pinned release tag when unset or "latest".

release_token.description: GitHub Actions secret expression for release operations (default: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}).

state_token.description: GitHub Actions secret expression for writing manifest state back to the trunk branch (default: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}).

release_token_app.description: Optional GitHub App identity that mints a short-lived installation token for release operations at run time instead of using a static secret. app_id and private_key are secret references, never raw key material.

state_token_app.description: Optional GitHub App identity that mints a short-lived installation token for writing manifest state at run time instead of using a static secret. app_id and private_key are secret references, never raw key material.

manifest_key.description: Nested key in the manifest file that holds the body (default: "ci").

action_folder.description: Folder name for the manage-release action (default: "manage-release").

builds.description: Build callbacks. Empty means no orchestrated builds.

deploys.description: Deploy callbacks. Empty means no deploys (library or CLI projects).

pin_mode.description: How action references are pinned (default: tag).

action_pins.description: Explicit action reference pins keyed by action name.

environment_config.description: Per-environment settings keyed by environment name.

secrets.description: Secrets passing for a callback. Either the scalar "inherit" (pass all caller secrets), the mapping {inherit: true}, or an explicit map of called-workflow secret name to caller secret name (least-privilege). inherit cannot be mixed with explicit keys.

runsOn.description: Runner selection. A single label, a list of labels, or a {group, labels} object (at least one of group or labels).

concurrencyConfig.description: Concurrency control for the generated orchestrate workflow.

cancel_in_progress.description: Cancel older in-progress runs (default: true). Set false to queue runs instead.

permissions.description: GITHUB_TOKEN permission scopes mapped to access levels.

inputs.description: Freeform inputs passed to the callback workflow.

envInputs.description: Per-environment inputs: a map of environment name to a freeform inputs map.

mode.description: Git identity mode: default (github-actions bot), custom (use user_name/user_email), or external (pre-configured).

gpg_key_secret.description: Secret name containing the GPG key.

workflow.description: Path to the reusable validation workflow.

triggers.description: Path patterns that should trigger validation.

workflow.description: Path to the reusable build workflow.
Path to the reusable deploy workflow.

artifactConfig.description: A release artifact produced by a build.

path.description: Glob pattern for files to include (for example "dist/*.tar.gz").

required.description: Fail the release if the artifact is missing (default: true).

passthroughArtifact.description: GitHub Actions artifact passing between jobs within a single orchestrate run.

upload.description: Path glob to upload after this job completes.

downloads.description: Names of upstream build jobs whose artifacts to download first.

matrixConfig.description: Build fan-out via a matrix. Builds only.

max_parallel.description: Cap on concurrent matrix legs (0 means the platform default).

canaryConfig.description: Canary rollout sub-block, used when rollout type is canary.

analysis.description: Workflow path that gates each wave.

percent.description: Single initial canary weight (1..100). RESERVED - not yet wired to generation.

bake_time.description: Soak duration after traffic shift before promotion (Go duration string, for example "30m"). RESERVED - not yet wired to generation.

promote_callback.description: Local callback workflow path invoked on promotion. RESERVED - not yet wired to generation.

rollback_callback.description: Local callback workflow path invoked on rollback. RESERVED - not yet wired to generation.

blueGreenConfig.description: Blue/green rollout sub-block, used when rollout type is blue_green.

switch.description: Workflow path that performs the blue/green cutover.

path.description: File to mutate in the target repo.

value.description: Value to write (may be a GitHub Actions expression).

branch.description: Target branch for the GitOps write (env-to-branch mapping); default is the target repo's default branch. Reserved.

track_sha.description: When true, record the post-push HEAD SHA of the target repo into state. Reserved.

publishConfig.description: Publish callback invoked after a release is published.

workflow.description: Path to the reusable publish workflow.

tag.description: callback.output reference for releases created by an external tool.

versionOverridesConfig.description: Reserved pointer to the version-intent override-file location. Reserved shape only: parse and structural validation, no generator behavior.

dir.description: Directory holding override files. Relative, no '..' segments. Empty means the implementation default (reserved).

notifyConfig.description: How a satellite repo notifies its primary after dev deploys.

repo.description: Primary repo to notify (for example org/my-backend).

token.description: Secret name for cross-repo dispatch (default: PRIMARY_REPO_TOKEN).

deploy_name.description: Deploy name to dispatch when the primary recognizes this satellite under a name that differs from its local deploy/build name. Defaults to the first local deploy name, then the first build name.

environment.description: Environment to dispatch when the primary expects an environment that differs from the satellite's first local environment. Defaults to the first local environment, then dev.

externalRepoConfig.description: An external repository this primary coordinates.

externalDeployConfig.description: A deployable from an external repository.

onUpdateConfig.description: What the receiver does when this external slot is recorded with a new version. Absent means record-only.

deploy.description: Run a scoped deploy in the same receiver run after the slot is recorded, scoped to the updated component.

workflow.description: Reusable workflow path, local or cross-repo (org/repo/.github/...@ref).

options.description: Valid values for a choice input.

merge_group.description: When present (even empty), wires the merge-queue trigger.

driftCheckConfig.description: Workflow drift-check PR lane. When enabled, cascade emits a pull_request workflow that runs cascade verify and fails on drift. When comment is also set, cascade emits the fork-safe workflow_run companion that posts the result as a sticky PR comment.

rollbackConfig.description: Opt-in configuration for the generated rollback workflow. Absent by default. When repository_dispatch is set, an external system can fire the same N-1 rollback the manual path performs by calling the dispatches API, carrying the parameters (environment, target, deployable, dry_run) in client_payload.

repository_dispatch.description: Adds a repository_dispatch trigger to the rollback workflow so an external signal can drive the rollback.

deploymentsConfig.description: Opt-in GitHub Deployments API integration. When enabled, the finalize job creates a Deployment per target environment and reports in_progress then success/failure status after each deploy.

enabled.description: Activates GitHub Deployments API reporting in the finalize job.

keep_prior_active.description: Prevents GitHub from auto-inactivating prior deployments for the same environment (auto_inactive:false). Default false relies on native auto-inactivation.

job_summary.description: Toggle the run-UI summary table. Reserved.

telemetryWebhook.description: Generic vendor-neutral JSON-POST telemetry sink. Reserved.

url.description: Destination the run posts telemetry to. Reserved.

secret_name.description: Name of a GitHub Actions secret holding the auth token (a reference, never an inline token). Reserved.

environmentConfig.description: Per-environment settings block. All fields are optional and additive; the cascade environments command emits these as an operator-appliable GitHub Environments REST config.

gha_environment.description: Maps this environment to a GitHub Environment (deployment records, required reviewers, wait timers, env-scoped secrets).

required_reviewers.description: User or team slugs that may approve a deployment to this environment (slugs, not numeric ids).

wait_timer.description: Delay in minutes before a job targeting this environment runs (0 to 43200).

branch_policy.description: Which branches may deploy: protected (protected branches only), custom (BranchPatterns/TagPatterns), or all (no restriction).

branch_patterns.description: Branch name patterns allowed to deploy when branch_policy is custom.

tag_patterns.description: Tag name patterns allowed to deploy when branch_policy is custom.

secrets.description: Expected env-scoped secret NAMES (names only, never values).

variables.description: Expected env-scoped variable NAMES (names only, never values).

environment_url.description: URL of the deployed environment, reported to GitHub Deployments API status updates.
